verdict.rationale: Kong describes declarative, database-less deployment "without any vendor lock-in" and makes all configuration available through a RESTful Admin API or declarative config. decK, Terraform providers and the Konnect audit-log pull API give programmatic access to configuration and logs, which together suggest data can be pulled out and taken elsewhere. However, no evidence documents an explicit full-export feature or names the open formats it would produce. Missing for 10: a documented export-all/dump capability covering Konnect SaaS data (catalog, Dev Portal, analytics), explicit open-format specification, documented offboarding/exit path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
